limits: Every original action and threshold preserved; no subtraction, filtering or synthetic replacement.
LoAF eligibility is selective and snapshot coverage is not a continuous rendering watermark. Absence of qualifying overlap does not establish idle rendering or transport causality.
Reported frame/script/forced-layout durations are wall intervals, not sampled CPU or proof of a specific React component.
EventTiming duration is quantized and includes processing and presentation delay. Inclusive Node commands mix transport, scheduler, actionability and browser work.
Per-stage quantiles are not additive. Browser clocks are not subtracted from Node clocks.
Phase grouping uses browser timeOrigin+start and declared wall phase times, not exact action attribution; exact primary joins use original same-document trusted click events.
Separate trace follow-up does not trace primary actions and cannot retroactively explain their transport costs.
